purpose: The Gambling Commission's Gambling Survey for Great Britain 2025: the share of adults who gambled in the past four weeks and the past twelve months, any gambling and excluding lottery-draw-only players, by sex crossed with age band (tables B.1 and B.3), and past-four-week participation by activity and channel, by sex and by age band (table B.9), Great Britain, calendar 2025: the adult rates the LCFS top_up_gambling_participation step brings the National Lottery and the betting and gaming keys to (microcosm#1359, PolicyEngine/chronicle#391).
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
